title: Copilot Studio: credit costs per agent and by lifecycle stage in the Monitor tab
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned Monitor cost breakdown from existing documented credit views and correctly qualifies the spending controls. The allocation API exists; minor corrections should shorten its printed call, complete the control paths and remove a reporting checklist item that has no controls-table row.

claims.quote: an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 accepts the printed environment scope and allocatedEntitlements body.
claims.quote:
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" `
    -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody
claims.fix: Replace the call in the structured row and rendered table with 'PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01'. Replace the note's opening '<rule> is ...' sentence with 'The request body sets scope.environmentId and allocatedEntitlements, with entitlementId MCSMessages, allocation.quantity, and enforcementRules containing ruleType TenantPool and enabled true or false.' Retain the environment-group override qualification.
